text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The wind sure is restless tonight.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Beni-ssimo! What a vivid melodia!
I must transcribe this musica played by the wind onto a score!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inspired by the sound of the wind, Sounds of Earth ended up staying up late...
